description:
[alert] Buy a 30-day watch with ONE payment and no account, checked every 60 seconds:
    your own position within max_dist_pct of its liquidation price (type=position), a metric of a
    coin crossing a threshold (condition), a liquidation cascade ending (cascade), or a Hyperliquid
    whale near liquidation (hl_near_liq). Returns watch_id; read its events with get_watch (free).
    Priced: $0.20 (x402, MPP), 40 prepaid credits, or a key's daily units.

api_key.description: LiquidVision API key (lv_...). Omit when the key is sent as the X-API-Key header on the connection.
api_key.title: Api Key

max_dist_pct.description: position / hl_near_liq: alert within this % of liquidation.
max_dist_pct.title: Max Dist Pct

metric.description: condition: funding_apr_pct | oi_chg_1h_pct | oi_chg_24h_pct | liq_1h_usd | liq_24h_usd | price_chg_1h_pct | price_chg_24h_pct | long_pct
metric.title: Metric

min_usd.description: cascade / hl_near_liq: minimum size in USD.
min_usd.title: Min Usd

symbol.description: Coin or contract, e.g. BTC. Required except for cascade.
symbol.title: Symbol

url.description: Optional HTTPS URL that also receives each event.
url.title: Url

name: create_watch
title: Create watch
